# StaticTable

The Static table: a fixed grid people read. Rows rest or are highlighted (`rowStates`); there is nothing to sort, select, page or expand, so it takes no hover and no row click. Reach for the Dynamic table when rows act or people work the data. Takes `headers` and `rows`, plus `size`, `frame`, `titleColumn`, `summary`, `verticalLines` and `striped`.

Also asked as: basic table.

## Usage

Use `StaticTable` for a grid people only read: a record, a summary, a rate
card.

## Alternatives

- For a table people sort or filter or page, use `Table`.

## Best practices

### Right-align numbers. {#right-align-numbers}

Do: Numbers align by their digits, so the amounts line up.
Don't: Left-aligned numbers do not line up.

### Name the record in one column. {#name-the-record-in-one-column}

Do: `titleColumn` marks the one column that names the row.
Don't: Emphasis on every cell, so nothing stands out.

### Let a cell longer than its column end in an ellipsis with a Tooltip. {#let-a-cell-longer-than-its-column-end-in-an-ellipsis-with-a-tooltip}

The Tooltip is on only while the cell is clipped, and the row keeps its height. A header wraps by default; one that must stay on one line sets `shouldTruncate`. See [Overflow](?path=/docs/patterns-states-overflow--docs).

### Keep a cell to one line. {#keep-a-cell-to-one-line}

Do: Long text truncates with an ellipsis and shows in full in a tooltip.
Don't: Every cell wrapped, so rows grow uneven.

## Accessibility

- **It is a real table.** Headers are `th` in a `thead`, so a screen reader announces the column for each cell.
- **Rows are not controls.** Nothing in a Static table takes focus; a table people interact with is a Dynamic table.
- **State is not color alone.** A selected row sets `aria-selected`, a disabled row `aria-disabled`.
- **Truncated text keeps its full value.** A cell that ends in an ellipsis shows the whole text in a tooltip.

## Parts

1. **Head cell.** A label with an optional type icon.
2. **Row.** Cells in a band; rest, highlighted, selected or disabled.
3. **Cell.** Text, a number, an icon or any node, with optional secondary text and an `elemBefore` slot.
4. **Summary row.** One calculation per column, muted, with no rule under it.

### States

| State | What changes |
| --- | --- |
| Rest | Clear row; a striped table shades alternate rows. |
| Hovered | Not applicable; a Static table never hovers. |
| Pressed | Not applicable; a Static table never presses. |
| Focused | Not applicable; a row is not a control. |
| Disabled | Disabled ink, no pointer events, `aria-disabled`. |
| Invalid | A cell with `state: 'error'` takes the danger ink. |

### Tokens

| Part | Token |
| --- | --- |
| Selected row | `--ds-background-selected`, `--ds-background-selected-hovered`, `--ds-background-selected-pressed` |
| Highlighted row | `--ds-background-warning-bold` washed |
| Disabled ink | `--ds-text-disabled` |
| Error ink | `--ds-text-danger` |
| Hairlines | `--ds-border` |
| Row height | `--row-height-sm`, `--row-height-md`, `--row-height-lg` |
| Cell padding | `--table-pad-x-cell`, `--table-pad-y-cell` |

## Content guidelines

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Title the one column that names the record. | Bold several columns. |
| Right-align numbers and keep units in the header. | Left-align numbers or repeat units in every cell. |
| Keep a cell to one line; let long text truncate with its tooltip. | Wrap every cell. |
| Use a dash for an empty cell. | Leave a cell blank or write "N/A". |

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `id` | string | — | The `id` of the `table` element. The wrapper takes `{id}-wrapper`. |
| `headers` | arrayOf | — | Column headers — a string, or { text, width, align } for control over layout; align is text, number or icon |
| `rows` | enum | — | Row data — each row is an array of cells; a cell is a node or { content, align, emphasis, overflow, secondary, elemBefore, state, loading, colSpan, className } |
| `striped` | bool | — | Alternate row background |
| `bordered` | bool | — | Frame the table and draw vertical lines |
| `verticalLines` | bool | — | Vertical hairlines between columns |
| `frame` | enum | — | Plain spans its section with no outer frame; framed draws its own edge |
| `size` | enum | — | Row height in pixels, from the Row size tokens |
| `titleColumn` | number | — | Index of the one column that names the record, set in semibold |
| `rowStates` | enum | — | One state per row: rest, highlighted, selected or disabled |
| `summary` | arrayOf | — | One calculation per column, in a muted row that closes the table |
| `emptyState` | node | — | Shown as a message row spanning every column when there are no rows |
| `footer` | node | — | A TableFooter under the rows |
| `className` | string | `''` | Extra class names added to the `table` element beside the component's own. |
| `style` | object | — | Inline styles for the table's wrapper element. |

## Variants

**`frame`** — `plain` · `framed`

**`size`** — `32` · `40` · `48`

The named string values each prop takes. A prop's full type is in Props: a prop listed here may also take a boolean or a number, and a prop missing here may still have named values.
